text:
jamie: Quick sync on rollout mechanics for the Optics routing feature. Need: clear waves, deterministic rollback, and CS comms. Who takes the runbook?

alisa: I'll own the runbook. Need the exact gating KPIs and the telemetry fields.

jamie: Primary pass/fail: delta customer error rate <= 0.3 percentage points, p50 latency +30ms cap, token-cost +5% cap. If any hard trigger hits, auto-fallback.

michael: Canary plan suggestion:
- Wave A: 2% tenant sample, shadow with 5% live traffic for 2h
- Wave B: regional warmup US-W/US-E 10% traffic for 6h
- Wave C: NA 50% + EU 10% staggered over 24h
Rollback: automatic if hard trigger persists for 10 minutes or 3 consecutive alert windows.

sara: Ops constraints: must include per-tenant circuit breaker, route-level tracing, and metric tags `optics_canary`. Also auto-fallback to `model-v1` on first fail.

jamie: Make rollback deterministic: thresholds + sustained window + operator confirm for soft breaches.

alisa: Proposed decision tree:
- Immediate auto-fallback if 5xx increases by >0.5pp OR p95 > +200ms for 5m
- If error +0.3pp or p95 +100ms for 10m -> page SRE and hold rollout

michael: Add quality gate: 30 eval prompts run every minute comparing canary vs baseline. If regression >2% flagged tokens, pause rollout.

jamie: Product owns the prompt list, Ops runs it. @cs_lead please prepare customer-facing messaging templates for a possible rollback.

cs_lead: Will prepare a short template: apology, scope, timeline, next steps, and opt-in/out instructions.

sara: I'll wire the eval check into preflight and add dashboard panels. Need the CSV of prompts.

jamie: I'll drop the CSV in /runbooks/optics/canary in the repo before EOD.

deploybot: deploy scheduled: optics-canary-1717456789 by alisa at 2023-10-18T14:00:00Z (dry-run). Status: queued. :gear:

michael: A couple more ops notes:
- Use sticky session affinity for A/B stability
- Flags: `optics_enabled`, `optics_experiment_id`
- Sampling seeded by tenant id then user id

jamie: Region policy: only ramp EU after NA 50% stable for 24h on primary KPIs.

alisa: Telemetry required per-flag: tokens, latency, error, cost-per-token, model-fallback-count. Dashboards should support per-region and per-tenant slices.

michael: Fallback hierarchy recommendation:
1) immediate routing -> `model-v1`
2) cheaper quantized variant `optics-quant`
3) degrade to short-mode (token limit) as last resort

jamie: Add org-wide kill-switch that sets `optics_enabled=false` and auto-notifies customers. One-click in Console.

alisa: Draft runbook snippet for Slack ops:
```
# ops playbook
if hard_breach:
  set_flag('optics_enabled', false)
  notify('#ops-alerts', 'Optics rollback triggered')
  run rollback_tests()
```

sara: We'll run a staging dry-run today. Plan a 30min sync with CS and SRE before Wave A.

jamie: Can we ship runbook + preflight jobs by EOD Friday?

michael: Yes, aiming for EOD. I'll push sampling code and the eval harness.

alisa: I'll build dashboards and alerts. Will post runbook link here when ready.

jamie: Thanks all. We'll iterate thresholds after first wave. :thumbsup:
